cases.task: We use an Atlassian Cloud custom domain and links are being treated like server links. What confluence-cli environment setting should I add?
cases.output_excerpt:
Add:

```sh
export CONFLUENCE_FORCE_CLOUD=true
```

This forces Cloud-style link handling for Atlassian Cloud custom domains when links are otherwise being interpreted like Server/Data Center links.
